title: Return Day on Hospital Leave: Hospital Stay Charge
content:
**Census and billing — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, hospital stay charge.** The return day never counts as a leave day: where the reservation's return date falls on one of the hospital stay entry's days, that day is not charged; where the return date falls after the entry's last day, or no return is recorded, no day is taken off for it.

| Return date on the reservation | Days taken off the hospital stay entry for the return day |
|---|---|
| on one of the entry's days, from its first day through its last day | 1 (the return day) |
| after the entry's last day | none |
| no return recorded | none |

**Hypothetical.** An entry booked from the 4th through the 19th with a return recorded on the 19th: the 19th is not charged. The same entry with a return recorded on the 23rd: no day is taken off for the return.
